text_original: Good morning, Mrs. Iyer. This is Arjun from Vigin Wealth. Thank you for taking my call.
Good morning, Arjun. Yes, go ahead.
I wanted to talk to you about a fantastic opportunity. Our small cap equity fund has been one of our best performers this year. A lot of our clients have seen really strong growth in it.
Small cap, isn't that quite risky? I usually prefer safer options, you know that. I've always kept my money in fixed deposits and liquid funds.
I understand, but honestly, in this market, staying too safe means you're missing out. Small caps have given much higher returns than anything else this year.
I really think you should put at least two lakhs into this.
I don't know. I've never really invested in equity before.
I'm a bit nervous about market ups and downs.
Don't worry too much about that, Mrs. Iyer. Yes, there will be some fluctuation,
but over time it evens out.
Given how well this fund has been doing, I wouldn't be too concerned.
I can go ahead and process this for you today.
If you think it's fine, I do trust your judgment, Arjun.
Absolutely. Trust me on this one.
I'll get the paperwork moving and we'll get you started with the small cap fund right away.
